description: This file defines the TaxAssembler class responsible for creating tax components and tax groups from JSON commands within the Fineract project. It includes methods for assembling TaxComponent and TaxGroup objects, handling validation, parsing JSON, and referencing external accounts and tax components.
external_methods: TaxComponent.createTaxComponent(String, BigDecimal, GLAccountType, GLAccount, GLAccountType, GLAccount, LocalDate)

classes.name: TaxAssembler
classes.description: A service class responsible for transforming JSON commands into tax data models, including tax components and groups, with validation and account account linking.

methods.name: assembleTaxComponentFrom
methods.description: Creates a TaxComponent object from JSON input, validating account information and parsing relevant fields.

methods.name: assembleTaxGroupFrom
methods.description: Creates a TaxGroup object from JSON input, including associated tax component mappings.

methods.name: assembleTaxGroupMappingsFrom
methods.description: Assembles a set of TaxGroupMappings based on JSON input, handling date parsing and references to TaxComponents.
